prompt_parts.label: Global Style
prompt_parts.content:
Global style:
# Megami Translation Style

Translate into natural English visual-novel prose while preserving the source's pacing and character voice.

Core rules:
- Keep Celica's narration in first person.
- Preserve page rhythm; do not merge or split lines during the pilot.
- Use glossary spellings for names, places, menus, and recurring terms.
- Keep English CP932-safe. Prefer ASCII punctuation.
- Use `...` instead of ellipsis characters and straight quotes instead of curly quotes.
- In the default vanilla text profile, never use apostrophes or contractions.
- In the apostrophe-patched text profile, ASCII apostrophes are allowed.
- Never use em dashes, en dashes, curly quotes, or mojibake punctuation.
- Keep each rendered textbox line at or below 50 visible characters.
- The 50-character limit is a hard technical limit. Shorter and plainer is better than overflowing.
- Speaker pages have one speaker line plus up to 3 dialogue lines.
- Narration pages have up to 4 lines.
- Do not translate script labels unless they are proven visible.
- Translate UI/menu text separately from prose.

Model output rules:
- Return JSON only.
- Return translations keyed by `line_id`.
- Do not invent, remove, or rename line IDs.
- Do not translate speaker names creatively; use glossary names.
- Do not include Japanese in English fields unless a term is intentionally left untranslated.
- If a literal translation is too long, compress it while preserving meaning and tone.

prompt_parts.label: Previous Scene Translations
prompt_parts.content:
Previous translated blocks in this scene:
{
  "scene_id": "s1:scene:0006",
  "omitted_earlier_translated_blocks": 18,
  "blocks": [
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01711-01716",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "レヴィアの報告は事務的に進められた。\n要約すると、俺達の探している十八年前に行方不明になった\nラティナ王女らしき人物は、確かに目撃されており。\nその姿は、この街から１ｋｍ程離れた廃坑で\n消えていると言う事だ。",
      "en": "Levia's report was businesslike. In summary, a person resembling Princess Latina, missing for eighteen years, was sighted. She disappeared in an abandoned mine about a kilometer from town."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01722-01724",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "そこで我々は\n明日から、その廃坑の調査を行う事にする……",
      "en": "Therefore, we will begin surveying that abandoned mine tomorrow..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01726-01729",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "其処でレヴィアが言葉を切り、室内を沈黙が支配する\n報告はまだ終わっていないようだが、レヴィアは\n口を開こうとしては躊躇い口籠もっている。\n……どうやら、言いにくい事があるようだ",
      "en": "Levia stopped speaking, and the room fell silent.\nThe report did not seem finished; Levia\nShe tried to speak but hesitated and faltered.\n...It seems she has something hard to say."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01738-01738",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "レヴィアが俺を睨むように見ている",
      "en": "Levia was staring at me as if glaring."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01740-01741",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "あ……",
      "en": "Ah..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01743-01744",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "？",
      "en": "Hm?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01746-01746",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "不意に俺と目の合ったレヴィアが顔を赤らめて視線を逸らした",
      "en": "Levia blushed and looked away when our eyes met."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01757-01758",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "ま、待て、何処へ行く？",
      "en": "W...wait, where are you going?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01760-01762",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "何処と言っても別に当ては無いがラティナ王女を\n捜すのだろう？",
      "en": "I have no particular destination, but we are searching for Princess Latina, no?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01764-01765",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "……報告がまだ残っている",
      "en": "...The report is not yet finished."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01767-01768",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "そうだったのか、では続けてくれ",
      "en": "I see. Continue."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01770-01771",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "……",
      "en": "..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01776-01777",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "……",
      "en": "..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01779-01780",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "続きは？",
      "en": "The rest?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01786-01787",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "それで？",
      "en": "So?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01789-01792",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "続きを促す俺の声に怒りの為、とは少し違う様子で\nレヴィアの顔が赤くなる\nなにか、様子が変だな……",
      "en": "When I urged her to continue, Levia's face flushed red, but not quite in anger. Something feels strange..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01798-01800",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Refin",
      "jp": "レヴィア将軍、後の報告は私の方から致しますので\n将軍は兵達の様子を見てきて頂けますか？",
      "en": "General Levia, I will finish the report.\nCould you please go check on the soldiers?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01806-01808",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "レヴィアの様子を見かねたレフィンが、助け船を出すように、\n声を掛けるが、レヴィアは其の言葉に逡巡するような間を\n置いた後、俺の目を真正面から見据えた。",
      "en": "Refin, unable to watch Levia any longer,\nthrew her a lifeline. But after a pause,\nLevia stared straight into my eyes."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01810-01812",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "いい、私から報告する\nこの街で目撃されているラティナ王女のことだが……",
      "en": "No, I'll give the report. About Princess Latina's sighting in this town..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01814-01815",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "何か、あるのか？",
      "en": "Is there something?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01817-01820",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "黙って聴け……そのラティナ王女の事だが……\n夜な夜な街に現れては街の男を襲い、\nその……精気を吸い取っているらしい……",
      "en": "Shut up and listen... About Princess Latina...\nNight after night, she appears, attacks men,\nand, well... drains their essence..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01822-01823",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "精気？　睡魔の様にか",
      "en": "Essence? Like a succubus?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01825-01826",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "そうだ……",
      "en": "That's right..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01828-01830",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "睡魔とは男の前には女、女の前には男の姿で現れ、\n男女の夜の営みを交いして相手から生命力ともいえる\n精気を吸い取って生きる悪魔の総称だ",
      "en": "A succubus is a type of demon that appears as a woman to men and as a man to women, engaging in nightly intimacies to drain their partner's essence, which is akin to life force."
    }
  ]
}
